Give each step the tool's arguments, valid against its arguments_schema, and a one-sentence rationale; use the dataset's own section ids, panel genes and label rule ids. The tools listed are the audits a plan may schedule. The controls (the random-thinning control and the label-sensitivity check) are not plan steps: after each audit runs, an agent reads its result and decides which controls it needs. If the question needs an analysis no listed tool provides, plan what the tools can do and say what is left out in the summary. Respond with JSON that matches the response schema.
